title: Tenable.io Agent
description: Endpoint-resident Tenable agent providing authenticated vulnerability assessment, configuration compliance evaluation, and software inventory without requiring network-based scanning.

implemented-requirements.description: The Tenable agent performs authenticated vulnerability scanning on the host and reports findings to a centralized vulnerability management platform.
The Tenable agent provides software and configuration inventory data to support accurate component inventory management.
Vulnerability findings inform flaw remediation and patch prioritization activities.
